These counting strategies help young learners develop number sense and foundational math skills. The first strategy shows counting individual objects, which is a fundamental skill in the Number and Number Sense domain (K.NS.1). The second strategy demonstrates counting on a number line, which helps with understanding sequences and basic addition (K.CE.1). The third strategy illustrates counting with fingers, a practical tool for early math development.
